title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Coliseum Arena on 1992-12-11
source: Dan Healy 2 track pa sbd dat master > Healy cassette (made by Dan for Phil Lesh) >  absconded & confiscated by Dick Latvala : ^) > analog to digital by kingbee using  Aoxoa's nak dragon for playback > panasonic sv3800 dat > HHb800> CDR

ai_review.summary: Excellent Healy soundboard capture of a tight ’90s performance, highlighted by stellar versions of Masterpiece, Aiko and Stagger Lee.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear Healy mix, noting that the recording is exceptionally tight and well balanced. Musically the show shines from “Masterpiece” onward, with an inspired take on “Aiko” and a standout rendition of “Stagger Lee,” while Jerry’s solos are repeatedly called exquisite.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are highly enthusiastic about the performance and the sound quality; despite only two reviews, their detailed praise justifies a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Great‑sounding Healy mix noted as crisp, tight, and well balanced throughout the show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert builds momentum early, really taking off at “Masterpiece,” and maintains a high‑energy flow through the highlighted cuts.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Solo work described as exquisite and a highlight of the performance.
